scope: purged validation 2021-2022; no new-model test outputs

design.scope: validation only; identical frozen alpha checkpoint per market
design.queue_status: 12 matched full validation controls queued after both-market GPU recovery and complete zero-penalty reproduction
design.goal: test whether more flexible marginal return variance improves portfolio results without changing alpha training or baseline strategy
variables: one/two/four Gaussian components in risk source
static or training-fitted regime risk multiplier

records.scope: complete purged validation and baseline backtest; audit excluded from search/promotion
complete purged validation and baseline backtest; audit excluded from search/promotion

notes: The alpha checkpoint is identical across all risk-source controls within each market.
Risk sources are complete seed-0 models; only component count and static/regime scoring vary.
Density improvement is not evidence of improved portfolio performance.
Smoke/reproduction audits are excluded from search and promotion.

resources.peak_scope: process lifetime; nested components share the process; parent time includes component fits

run.selection: validation only; 5 boundary days purged by default

fixed_alpha.json.scoring: same alpha checkpoint reused; no alpha optimizer or new epoch selection
fixed_alpha.json.seed_policy: alpha source follows parent seed; variance source retains its configured seed

risk_source.json.training: both alpha and risk networks are frozen; only training-feature regime statistics are fitted
